email_subject: Application - Full-Stack Developer / Shopify Expert (eCommerce CRO Focus)
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Full-Stack Developer / Shopify Expert role. I work where front-end code, SEO and analytics meet: I've built and maintained Shopify storefronts (harwindtf.com, custompremiumshirt.com) — design, product catalogue, custom landing pages — and earlier worked as a front-end developer on an AngularJS/JavaScript healthcare app in Belgium.

Today I build WordPress and hand-coded sites, run technical audits, implement JSON-LD structured data, and read behaviour and performance data in GA4, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and I'd rather be judged on conversion and page-speed results than on tickets closed.

I'll be upfront about the gap: production Liquid and a formal A/B testing programme are where I'd learn fastest, and I'd bring the analytics and optimisation instincts with me. My CV is attached — I'd welcome a conversation.

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your listing asks for someone who owns storefront performance end to end — and who can prove it with numbers. That is the kind of work I've been doing, though my route there has been through SEO, analytics and front-end code rather than a Shopify-only job title.

On Shopify I've handled store design, product catalogue build-out, landing pages and blog content for harwindtf.com and custompremiumshirt.com. Earlier, at ViviDoctor in Belgium, I developed and optimised front-end features in AngularJS and JavaScript for a healthcare web application — which is where I learned to care about page weight, mobile responsiveness and clean markup. Since then I've built sites by hand (a WebGL hero landing page with accessible markup and structured data) and in WordPress/Elementor, and I still write HTML, CSS and JavaScript daily, alongside Python automation and an Android app live on Google Play.

On the CRO side, I run technical audits and iterative improvements, implement JSON-LD schema, and work from GA4, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs data. On mirook.com, repeated technical SEO and GEO audits measurably raised the site's search-health score — a small but real example of measuring, changing and re-measuring.

What I'd need to build is production-level Liquid and a disciplined A/B testing pipeline. I'd rather say that plainly than overstate it. What I bring from day one is a technical eye for performance, a habit of writing documented, maintainable code, analytics literacy, and the self-direction to spot a problem, fix it, and report what changed.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, open to remote work, and happy to show you the sites I've built.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
